---
name: Data report
about: Report a correction, a confirmation, or something missing -- a peak, trailhead, permit, water source, campground, park access rule, etc.
title: "[data] "
labels: data
---

**What is this about?**
Name the peak, trailhead, water source, campground, or permit group this
concerns (e.g. "Mount Carillon", "Boyd Camp", "Del Valle Regional Park").
If it's not in the dataset at all, say so here -- that's exactly how to
report something missing.

**What are you reporting?**
The correction, confirmation, or new fact itself.

**Evidence** (optional)
A link, a photo description, who told you, a GPS track, etc. Please do
**not** paste copyrighted source documents (Sierra Club publications,
etc.) -- a link or citation is enough.

**How confident are you?** (check one)
- [ ] Firsthand -- you saw or experienced it yourself
- [ ] Official source -- a citable page or document (link it above)
- [ ] Told by staff -- a ranger, gate attendant, or reservation agent told you in person
- [ ] Secondhand -- you believe this but haven't independently confirmed it

**Which file, if you know?** (optional -- leave blank if unsure)
e.g. `data/peaks.csv`, `data/water_sources.csv`, `data/approaches.csv`,
`data/campgrounds.csv`, `data/park_access.csv`. A maintainer will figure
this out if you're not sure.
